faq.title: Questions people ask before starting
faq.intro: A few of the most common ones. The full list is on our FAQ page.

how.a: You choose the area you want help with and answer a short assessment — about a minute. Based on your answers you're matched with one or two suitable solutions, and your assessment goes to a medical review. A prescription is issued only if it is considered appropriate for you.

prescription.a: No. The assessment result is a recommendation, not a guarantee of treatment. A prescription is issued only when a doctor decides it is medically appropriate.

time.a: The assessment itself takes about 60 to 90 seconds. The medical review is handled separately, and you're notified when there's an update.

appointment.a: No. Everything is completed online at your own pace — no waiting rooms, no fixed appointment times.

privacy.a: Yes. Your personal and health data is encrypted and handled in line with the GDPR. Only the people involved in your medical review can see it.
